name: v138_epsr_negative_revision_decay16_market
hypothesis: The 1QF EPSR negative-revision parent is the cleanest remaining low-correlation seed. A slightly slower decay and MARKET neutralization may lift Fitness above the strict gate without adding option or sales terms.
expression: 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_epsr_mean, 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_epsr_mean, 63), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_epsr_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.140 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Repair of 78wm00YZ/88zPaAbV. It missed Fitness by 0.02 and had low corr (~0.65). No option/PCR/sales/PTP/gross-income guidance.

name: v138_capex_grossprofit_no_reversal

notes: Parent shift from rKojvzR9: remove close/open reversal and add cap gate + volume exhaustion. Strict-check against MPp7RPxn, qMAGvOe2, and capex/FCF actives.
